name: Parallel Session Concurrency Skill
purpose: Coordinates any number of concurrent project sessions without hardware resource contention, memory exhaustion on Apple Silicon, or workspace governance collisions: authoring runs in parallel, heavy jobs queue one at a time.
capabilities: Unlimited worktree sessions: authoring stages run in parallel, heavy jobs (render, TTS, analysis) share one host lock via scripts/session-guard.py
First-come-first-served wait queue with periodic progress logging and crash-safe job-tree teardown
Session lifecycle: session-start, session-list dashboard, session-end with render/audio rescue and merge-conflict pre-check
Playbook for N parallel sessions: commit first, stay inside projects/<slug>/, finish with session-end --merge

installation.instructions: Built-in workspace skill. No installation needed.

compatibility.notes: Protects Apple Silicon M2 unified memory by running one Chromium or PyTorch workload at a time across all sessions.

security.notes: Coordinates locks via .locks/ and runs guarded project commands.

approval_evidence: Production tested with concurrent lock acquisition and project-scoped governance gates.
